specification.title: Research-required malware context end-to-end
specification.description: A content-delivery domain whose resolved IP carries a strong AbuseIPDB reputation and a ThreatFox malware association. The production Coordinator must authorize research on the malware family; the production Research Agent must execute against the deterministic repository corpus; the final Assessment keeps verdict authority and the report consumes the actual Research as context only.
specification.purpose: Verify the research dimension of the end-to-end path: Coordinator authorization, production Research Agent execution with citation closure, Research remaining separate from Evidence, and the report keeping Assessment authority over Research context.
specification.operational_relevance: Malware-family context is a core enrichment for analyst decisions; contextual Research must never become Evidence or override the Assessment verdict.
specification.regression_risk: The Coordinator could skip research authorization, the Research Agent could fail citation closure, or the report could treat Research claims as verdict authority.

required: Research is authorized and executes for the malware family
The persisted ResearchResult cites supplied repository chunks
Research remains separate from Evidence and never creates Evidence
The report keeps the Assessment verdict authority over research context
forbidden: Research results collide with Evidence identities
The report references research material that was not supplied
